name: KETOROLAC 30 MG/1 ML INJECTABLE SOLUTION 3 AMPOULES
description: Ketorolac is a potent nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID) used for the short-term treatment of moderate to severe pain. It is often prescribed for pain following surgery or other painful medical procedures. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
